messages:
Alex: Ran a high-sample microprobe against /v1/generate this morning — want to capture odd kernel-time skew and get dashboard ideas.
Maya: Nice. top-line numbers?
Alex: quick summary from 10k token samples over the 09:00–09:10 window:
```
samples: 10000
median TTFT: 42ms
median per-token decode: 14ms
median kernel time (inclusive): 26ms
kernel breakdown (median): gemm=17.8ms, softmax+ln=3.9ms, kv-lookup=1.5ms
kv_cache_hit_rate: 68%
avg batch size: 3.7
```
Maya: That kv hit rate is lower than expected. Any pattern by seq_len or route? :thinking:
Alex: Yes — stratified view shows short seq (<32) have ~78% hit, long seq (>=128) drop to ~42%. Also kernel mix shifts: long seqs see a larger gemm proportion and slower softmax variance.
Dmitri: Could be batching heuristic + softbatch handshake causing microbatch pause. Do we have per-batch handshake time in the probe logs?
Alex: We do. Sample log lines:
```
TRACE probe=mp-2026 id=abc123 route=/v1/generate token_idx=12 seq_len=64 batch_size=4 ttft_ms=58 kernel=gpu_gemm kv_hit=true kernel_time_ms=19.6 handoff_ms=2.1 prequeue_ms=5.4
```
Sophia: Helpful. For dashboards I'd want: waterfall stacked by (prequeue, handoff, kernel_gemm, kernel_softmax, kv_lookup), heatmap by route x kernel, and p99 vs p50 delta panels.
Maya: Agreed. PromQL-ish sketches: `avg_over_time(token_ttft_ms[5m]) by (route, kernel)` and for p99: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))`
Ravi: Also add labels: `kernel=gemm|softmax|bias` and `kv_hit=true|false` so queries can split by kv behavior. That will help attribute TTFT vs decode vs kv.
Dmitri: Sampling bias note — microprobe was uniform across requests, but we need stratified sampling by `seq_len_bin` and `batch_size_bin` to avoid overcounting the long-seq edgecases that skew kernel fraction.
Alex: Proposed sampling config:
```
microprobe.sample_rate=0.01
microprobe.stratify_by=[route, seq_len_bucket(batch: [0,32,64,128,256]), batch_size_bucket([1,2,4,8])]
push_to_metric_prefix=token_probe.*
```
Sophia: For viz, suggest one panel that shows per-route "kernel delta" when toggling quantized kernels vs full kernels (helps evaluate kernel-selector changes). We should surface cost impact too: tokens * avg_gpu_ms -> estimated $/10k tokens.
Maya: We need kernel attribution to be conservative: split kernel_time into `compute` vs `memory` where possible. Add microprobe fields: `kernel_mode=compute|membound` from perf counters.
Alex: Ran a quick correlation: routes with high p95 TTFT spikes correlated with increased `kv_miss` and elevated `handshake_ms`. Hypothesis: when kv miss increases, fallback causes extra kernel ops and also disables some batching optimizations.
Ravi: Ops — plan for experiment? I can run a 10% canary that flips `kernel_selector.v2` and enables aggressive kv-prefetch for that subset.
Dmitri: Before that, let's add two dashboard alerts: (1) p95 TTFT increase > 20% over baseline for any route, (2) kv_miss_rate delta > 10% absolute. That way canary will auto-fail fast.
Sophia: I'll sketch the grafana panels and mock data. Temp link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/xyz123/token-kernel-synthesis (private)
Alex: Also adding an instrumentation TODO: surface `kvcache.lookup_time_ms` as its own metric (currently buried in log string). That'll let us attribute more precisely without parsing traces.
Maya: For the kernel-selector tuning, we should capture `attempted_kernel` vs `chosen_kernel` in probe logs so we can see fallback frequency.
Alex: Example enriched trace line: `TRACE probe=mp-2026 id=abc124 route=/v1/generate seq_len=160 token_idx=3 ttft_ms=120 attempted_kernel=quant_gemm chosen_kernel=fallback_gemm kv_hit=false`
Ravi: I'll coordinate the canary and add rollout plan: 10% -> monitor 30m -> 50% -> rollback if alerts fire.
deploy-bot: deploy job started for canary/kernel-selector-v2 @3402100200 :rocket:
Dmitri: One more ask — when we compute per-route KPIs, include `tokens_generated` and `avg_requests_per_minute` to normalize p99 cost.
Sophia: I'll add a panel showing "percent of p99 attributable to kernel_gemm" using `sum by(route) (rate(token_kernel_gemm_ms_sum[5m])) / sum by(route) (rate(token_ttft_ms_sum[5m]))`.
Alex: Great. Action items: Maya (add probes + prometheus metrics), Sophia (grafana panels + mock), Dmitri (sampling config + stratify), Ravi (canary rollout), Alex (instrument kvcache lookup metric). I'll post probe config and sample CSV in the thread.
Maya: On it. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Alex: Dropping a small CSV snippet for the probe-run in this thread for anyone who wants to replay locally.
```
id,route,seq_len,batch_size,ttft_ms,kernel_time_ms,kv_hit
mp-0001,/v1/generate,16,2,34,10.2,true
mp-0002,/v1/generate,160,4,118,45.1,false
mp-0003,/v1/embed,8,1,22,7.9,true
```
Maya: Perfect. Let's reconvene after the initial canary results.
